Number of students studying commerce in institute D is what percent of the total number of students of the 5 institutes
solution:
**Calculation:**

Number of students studying commerce in institute D = 55

Total number of students in Arts = (36 + 45 + 55 + 45 + 48) = 229

Total number of students in Science = (48 + 54 + 36 + 48 + 44) = 230

Total number of students in Commerce = (59 + 55 + 56 + 55 + 52) = 277

Total number of students in Computer science = (57 + 48 + 51 + 53 + 55) = 264

Total number of students of the 5 institutes = (229 + 230 + 277 + 264) = 1000

Required percentage = (55/1000 ×100)

⇒ (55/10)

⇒ 5.5

**The required percentage is 5.5**
